title: smime-tree: aes-gcm dependency listed but never used
description: Cargo.toml lists aes-gcm as a dependency, but decrypt.rs returns UnsupportedAlgorithm immediately for GCM content types — there is no actual AES-GCM code path. Dead dependency: increases compile time, increases supply-chain attack surface, and misleads contributors into thinking GCM is implemented. Fix: remove aes-gcm from [dependencies].
